body_html:
#poetryport

Any ending
must welcome a new
beginning

Night recedes carried
on whistles of bird songs
chirps keeping time

Cover on a book closes,
one last time, as minds
open new ideas fluttering
with
Hornworms welcoming a
cascade of flying sphinx's
As the gold of a Monarch
takes flight

Poems reborn in
the litter of cliche
close out #poetryport
in hopes of welcoming
recycled meaning
tomorrow
